The '''YT-2400 light freighter''' was a [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] produced by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] similar to the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]].

[[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar's]] [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']] was a heavily modified YT-2400 [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], and perhaps the most famous example of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] amongst [[Fringer/Legends|fringers]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:YT2400schematics-SS.png|thumb|left|180px|YT-2400 deck plan [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]]]]
Favored by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] featured the [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]] trademark saucer-shaped [[Hull/Legends|hull]] and starboard-mounted command pod. Like most [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian]] designs, the YT-2400 was fast, tough, and endlessly modifiable.<ref name="EVV" /> Stock YT-2400s were 18.65 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, required two [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], and were armed with two [[1D servo turret/Legends|1D servo turret]] [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]&mdash;mounted dorsally and ventrally. The ship came with a total of 13 weapon emplacement points, with only 6 used in the stock configuration, allowing for easy modifications to the stock frame. Thus, the design was favored by [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and smugglers, or any other being in need of a well-armed [[Transport/Legends|transport]].

With double-armored hull plating and bulky engines, the YT-2400 could easily handle the strain of deep-space combat. The vessel had power to spare and an oversized hull begging for hot-rodded engines and powerful weapons.<ref name="EVV" />

<div style="float:right">[[File:Outrider_btm.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']] was arguably the most famous YT-2400]]</div>
The YT-2400 was configured with a pair of starboard bracing arms that connected to the cockpit compartment, essentially a long tube. The aft section of the cockpit tube contained the primary escape pod, which seated six. The bracing arm's interior space generally was used for crew quarters and living space.

The rounded hull area was devoted to cargo holds and ship's systems. In practice, much of the interior hull space was taken up by modified engines, power generators, weapons systems, and all the other illegal goodies any self-respecting smuggling ship needed. A second escape pod, as well as the airlock, was located on the far side of the cargo compartment, directly opposite the bracing arms.

By [[137 ABY]], the YT-2400 freighter was apparently still in use, as the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] utilized the ''[[Scarlet Star]]''.
